profile.headline: Software Engineer at Medical Informatics Engineering, Inc

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed new features requested by clients for a web-based electronic health record application.
Mitigated bugs reported by technical support and clients.
- Researched root cause on both client and server side
- Patched fixes for both development and production systems
Designed MySQL queries to calculate Meaningful Use measures per the provided specifications.
- Updated previously written measures to meet new specifications
- Wrote new measures not previously calculated
Participated in code reviews to ensure code quality

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Developed a web based staffing portal to support multiple companies and multiple contracts in a SCRUM based Agile development environment
- Designed and implemented clients side user interface with HTML, Javascript, and jQuery 
- Implemented a controller layer using Java and Hibernate 
- Used Ajax to facilitate database calls from the client side 
- Maintained MySQL database and Jenkins continuous integration environment on a Linux server 
- Increased client and server side test coverage to facilitate validation and verification of application 
- Maintained version control in Git

positions.title: Product Support Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a tool to automate and standardize build plan procedure
     - Facilitated collaboration between departments and with third-party vendors
     - Headed the compilation of all deliverables for build plan generation
     - Learned Microsoft Access and VBA to implement stakeholder feedback
    - Trained engineers on use of tool and defined a departmental procedure
Transformed design and use of blood glucose meter configuration databases
     - Streamlined new configuration database to fit SQL relational model
     - Created a departmental procedure for database use by any engineer
Tested and troubleshot on multiple platforms
     - Reimaged to a clean machine then verified install of new software
     - Reproduced errors to incorporate in troubleshooting guide
     - Determined process to install software for English Windows 7 on German Win 7

positions.title: Edison Engineering Software Intern
positions.description:
Integrated into an Agile Development Department within a SCRUM team
     - Became a certified software tester by GE’s FDA compliant training standards
Developed and tested Medical Record Number Org Sharing Stored Procedures
     - Prevented duplicate or missing MRNs during hospital group mergers
     - Reduced required work of service engineers by 15 hours per service call
     - Gained knowledge of SQL Agent Jobs and lock escalation
Investigated the upgrade from Crystal Reports 11 to Crystal Reports 14
     - Discovered SDKs were no longer supported
     - Reported the upgrade from VB6 to .NET would require Crystal Server 2011
